scope: Outcome-blind versioned data-construction repair and frozen prospective specification only. No GPU execution, phase-I extraction, model inference, training, candidate scoring, external-benchmark evaluation, fine-mapping, target-gene analysis or manuscript revision.

pretraining_1_0.interpretation: Historical failed construction attempt; its frozen data, results and decision rule are not reinterpreted or retroactively amended. This file defines the prospective pretraining-1.1 decision rule.

model_terminology.h3k27me3: H3K27me3-associated region-label model, not an experimentally established silencer classifier

context: same-donor severe-emphysema lung; bulk lobe-level provenance does not establish matched single cells or aliquots

V2-A.labels: unchanged V1 positive population and historical controls

V2-B.role: orientation-corrected plus donor-accessible matched-control diagnostic ablation
V2-B.labels: prefer complete V1 positive population; only if infeasible, explicitly recorded outcome-blind common-support restriction retaining at least 90% under the frozen construction specification

V2-C.role: orientation-corrected plus donor-accessible matched controls plus same-lobe labels; intended final corrected model
V2-C.labels: same-lobe positives, subject only to explicitly recorded outcome-blind common-support restriction retaining at least 90% under the frozen construction specification
V2-C.controls: independently C-matched donor-accessible, relevant-mark-absent controls; never unchanged reuse of the B control manifest

ablation_interpretation.A_to_B: historical controls replaced by matched donor-accessible controls; if common-support restriction is needed, positive-population restriction is an additional explicit change
ablation_interpretation.B_to_C: same-lobe label correction plus induced independent control rematching; if restriction differs, report both positive-population restrictions explicitly
ablation_interpretation.pure_label_membership_change: quantify directly from the full pre-restriction and retained positive interval manifests; do not infer an isolated label effect from the trained B-versus-C comparison
ablation_interpretation.native_configuration_metrics: descriptive only because labels, controls and prevalence can differ

training.phase_I: frozen inference-mode representation; never random fallback
training.phase_II: independent initialization using fixed seed, unchanged V1 architecture
training.software: Preserve original TF2.20.0/Keras3.14.1 environment captured in architecture audit; exact environment must be checked before any later approved execution.

augmentation.cache: g(forward nucleotide sequence) and g(RC nucleotide sequence) independently; never reverse 4560-dimensional embedding

inference.seed_aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of all3 seeds in fixed seed order
inference.ref_alt_identity: complement independently, do not exchange REF and ALT
inference.finite_range_gate: all per-orientation, per-seed and ensemble region probabilities finite and in [0,1]
inference.validation_scope: after separately authorized training, compare original versus nucleotide-RC inputs for every frozen internal validation-panel sequence, at each seed and the ensemble, with inference-mode stochastic layers disabled; require abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(b). CPU algebra/synthetic checks cannot substitute for this real-network gate.

chromosome_partitions.test_interpretation: fixed internal holdout from V2 training and model selection, not historically untouched; V1 and prior construction exposed aspects of chr8-9
chromosome_partitions.test_pretraining_access: construction variables, covariate balance, support, sequence integrity, contamination, provenance and leakage QC only; no model scores, performance or thresholds may guide construction

checkpoint.data: configuration-native labels and controls on global chr7 checkpoint-role IDs only

validation_roles.unit: global full2001bp overlap components unioned by encoded-sequence/RC identity
validation_roles.matching_pair_roles: identical global role; lobe need not be an exact pairwise stratum in the repaired matching algorithm

common_panels.task: the final retained C biological region-label task in each model context
common_panels.A_B_C_comparability: all three configurations evaluated on identical sequence IDs, labels and component units separately within each common panel
common_panels.calibration_positive_use: retained for transparent counts/descriptive reporting only; no positive score is used to choose the operating threshold
common_panels.training_chr_covariate_normalization: source-specific ATAC mapping and stratification cutpoints use training chromosomes only, then apply unchanged to chr7 and chr8-9

selection.meaning_of_selection_role: absolute internal adequacy assessment of intended configuration C; paired A/B/C ablation reporting, not configuration competition
selection.panel: common C-task chr7 selection-role panel, independently for enhancer and H3K27me3-associated contexts

bootstrap.unit: global genomic overlap/encoded-sequence component, conditional on fixed matching design; not matching links between distant loci
bootstrap.paired: same resampled component IDs and multiplicities across model predictions
bootstrap.resample: sample represented component IDs with replacement, same number of components as observed; carry all component rows
bootstrap.invalid: one-class draw or undefined metric; no imputation; count attempted/invalid draws explicitly
bootstrap.failure: if fewer than 2000 valid draws or invalid fraction >=0.10 among all attempted draws, adequacy is INCONCLUSIVE and release stops; do not change seed, confidence level or resampling unit
bootstrap.generalization_limit: conditional internal genomic-component uncertainty, not independent-donor or population generalization

selection.minimum_selection_scope: each model context separately; count distinct represented global overlap/encoded-sequence components, not interval rows or matching pairs

adequacy.construction_gates: PASS for both B and C, with support and sample/component minima met before any training review
adequacy.seeds: all three required seeds completed for each C model; no favorable-seed subset
adequacy.definition: all conditions are conjunctive, evaluated for the fixed equal-three-seed C ensemble on the common chr7 selection panel separately in BOTH model contexts
adequacy.equality_at_null_boundary: FAIL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; equality does not pass the strict lower-confidence-bound gate
adequacy.no_extra_minimum_delta: the old comparative 0.02 margins are not absolute adequacy requirements

selection.AP_gain: compute AP minus prevalence separately in every bootstrap replicate, then take the lower percentile of those differences; do not subtract the original-sample prevalence from an AP-only confidence limit
selection.brier_skill: 1 - mean((probability-label)^2)/[replicate_prevalence*(1-replicate_prevalence)]; the baseline is the constant predictor at that replicate's prevalence; compute skill in each valid replicate before the confidence interval
selection.seed_stability_definition: compute sample standard deviation with ddof=1 and range over the three seed-specific symmetric AP point estimates on the identical common chr7 selection panel, separately by model context; either strict exceedance stops C retention
selection.seed_gate_consistency_note: For exactly three values, sample SD >= range/2. Thus a passing SD<=0.03 entails range<=0.06, making the preserved range>0.10 stop redundant but not contradictory. Both historical numerical limits remain unchanged; no data-driven revision is made.
selection.reliability: ten fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; descriptive, no fitted recalibration
selection.stratification: GC quintiles, train-derived ATAC-rank quintiles and repeat quintiles using retained C TRAIN positive cutpoints only; apply fixed cutpoints to all configurations' common panels. Also report lobe support, chromosome and ambiguous-base status; cells<100 observations descriptive only.

paired_ablation_report.uncertainty: paired component-bootstrap differences on the same C-task selection panel; report point estimates and 95% confidence intervals; paired 90% intervals may also be supplied descriptively under the preserved percentile definition
paired_ablation_report.Brier_direction: negative difference means lower Brier error for the first configuration

old_margin_record.status: historical pretraining-1.0 comparative margins only, retired from prospective decision-making; not absolute adequacy gates

selection.retention: Retain intended configuration V2-C only if BOTH model contexts pass every absolute adequacy, seed-stability, real-network invariance and sample/component gate and the calibration contract is satisfied. No C-versus-B superiority, equivalence or noninferiority condition applies.
selection.C_failure: STOP; no automatic A/B fallback, mixed configuration or favorable-seed selection. Any proposed scientific redesign requires separately authorized new versioning before new model outcomes are used.

threshold.data: only independently C-matched common chr7-calibration negative-control distribution after C adequacy, checkpoint and ensemble freeze
threshold.component_minimum_provenance: new conservative pretraining-1.1 clarification: extend the unchanged selection-component floor to calibration controls to operationalize the user-required selection/calibration component safeguard; not derived from model outcomes
threshold.formula: k=floor(0.05*n); d=descending negative scores; t=nextafter(d[k] in zero-based indexing,+infinity)
threshold.allowed_numerical_edge_case: threshold may be slightly above 1 if a boundary score equals 1; do not clip it back to 1 or split ties
threshold.operating_predictor: fixed equal-three-seed nucleotide-RC-symmetric C ensemble; per-seed calibration is descriptive only and cannot replace the ensemble rule
threshold.empirical_FPR_gate: observed number of called calibration controls <=floor(0.05*n), with exact threshold serialization round-trip; failure is a stop, not permission to optimize a different rule
threshold.dependence_caveat: the rule bounds the observed calibration-row fraction only; the component minimum does not turn it into a prospective population-FPR confidence guarantee

prospective_execution_order: Freeze pretraining-1.1 specifications, interval manifests, common panels and hashes after independent CPU construction validation; report readiness for investigator review only.
STOP now. Training and feature extraction require a separate explicit investigator authorization.
After future authorization only, train all 18 prespecified fits; select checkpoints solely by each native chr7 checkpoint-role symmetric BCE.
Freeze all three checkpoints per configuration/head and the symmetric ensemble implementation; run mandatory real-network invariance and finite-range checks using validation sequences.
Assess C absolute adequacy and seed stability separately for both heads on the common chr7 selection panel; report A/B/C paired ablations without using their ordering for retention.
If either C head fails or is inconclusive, stop without A/B fallback, test/external opening or new threshold tuning.
If both C heads pass, freeze the internal adequacy decision and calibrate each C ensemble using only its dedicated common chr7 calibration controls under the fixed threshold formula.

Freeze C checkpoints, seed ensemble, inference contract, calibration thresholds and decision record before test opening; apply them unchanged to chr8-9 for fixed internal-holdout reporting. Test findings cannot select A/B or retune any model/threshold.

External benchmark access remains separately out of scope for this construction repair; any later authorized one-time evaluation occurs only after all internal decisions are frozen and cannot cause outcome-guided redesign.

candidate_plan.historical_V1_P95: historical descriptive comparator only, not calibrated allele-effect FDR
candidate_plan.region_threshold_limit: region-label calibration is not an allele-effect, variant-level FPR, causal-probability or mechanistic-evidence calibration

external_firewall.permitted_pretraining_access: opaque file hashing only; no parsed benchmark outcomes/labels
external_firewall.open_once_only_after: separate authorization plus retained C checkpoints, all3 seeds, inference contract, thresholds and internal adequacy record frozen; no redesign after external outcome

stop_conditions: insufficient common selection/calibration samples or components
later missing seed, seed instability, prediction invalidity or real-network invariance failure
later failed or inconclusive C absolute adequacy

numerical_margin_review.old_comparative_0_02_margins: not transferred into absolute gates and not used to accept/reject C
numerical_margin_review.seed_SD_and_range_limits: preserved exactly; range gate redundant for three seeds
numerical_margin_review.bootstrap_quantile_levels: preserved 95% lower-bound adequacy assessment; no post-result switch to 90% intervals
numerical_margin_review.adequacy_claim_limit: These strict above-null safeguards are minimal internal statistical adequacy, not prespecified clinically meaningful effect sizes or proof of variant-mechanism utility.
